facts.fact: Angola's Government Data Center (Data Center e Cloud do Governo, owned by INFOSI, Camama-Kilamba, Luanda) was inaugurated on 28 April 2026 and runs 24 hours a day, serving government systems and public and private digital platforms; it is designed to the Tier III standard of the Uptime Institute (design standard only, no certification stated).
